book.name: Apocalipsis
book.title: Apocalipsis Re kwaan mlu Jesucrist lo Juan

content: Bid cheen ngwnaa, me nto cho
Nu tub re mandad, lo gazh mandad, xaa mzen kop cheen yalnayii cheen Dios mbid lo na, nu né: —Te, zee luu na lo lu bid kwaan ded ngwnaa, me nto cho lo re xaabyi, me nak tub yezh nzob gax lo nis.
Lee re rey, xaa nabeyy yizhyo mchaal kwaan lee me, nu re kwaan nawent kwaan nle me nak kwenta xis ub kwaan nzho re xaa yizhyo zee nzuzh xaa.

Nu Mbi Naban cheen Dios mle zee mbe mandad na axta wen; nu myun tub ngwnaa, me nzob tich tub ma nakap, lo na, ma naxne na nu cho ma nkee zyen wdizh kwaan nii nawent nak Dios, nu nzob gazh yek ma nu chii xkach ma.

Nu lee ngwnaa zee nak tub ler chul, kwaan na kolor morad nu naxne, nu nkano me or, nu nzhi re ke chul nlu lo me, nu re ke rus kwaan le perla. Nu yaa me nzho tub kop kwaan nyazhe kwaan re kwaan mbeed kwaan mle me nu kwaan re kwaan nawent mle me kwaan re xaabyi.
Kwaane nak tub kwaan nabix. Nu lechuzh me nkee le me: “Babilonia yezh ndok, yezh kwaan nak xnaa re ngwnaa me nto cho nu xnaa re xaa nle kwaan beed”.
Zee myun ngwnaa ne lo na, nzuzh me kwaan ren cheen re xaa mle nambey Jesús, nu cheen re xaa nzaa kwent cheen Jesús. Nu gorna myun me lo na, mdedyall na.
Nu lee mandad né lo na: —¿Chozhiin ndedyall lu? Na nii xomod nak kwaan nabix ne lo lu, cheen ngwnaa nu cheen ma nakap, ma nzob me tich, ma nzob gazh yek nu chii kach yek.

Lee ma nakap, ma myun lo lu ngu yilo, nu nal nyent ma, per merla roo ma leen yerdoo, per napa tira lux ma. Lee re myet yizhyo, xaa nankeet le lo Yech cheen Yalnaban, axta leezha zeeraka dexkwaa yizhyo, dedyall xaa ne xaa lo ma nakap, ma mban yilo, nu nyent nal, per bare yaad.
’Kwaan nabix ne nzho mod la yek re xaa nzho yek, lee gazh yek ma nak gazh yi, pa nzob ngwnaa ba tich, nu lee yek ma noka nak gazh rey.
Gaay re rey ne ngutla nu lee stub rey nabeyy nal nu lee stub rey nzho jwalt nabeyy. Per gorna nabeyy xaa gwluzhtlaka naxchet nabeyy xaa.
Lee ma nakap, ma ngu yilo, nu nyent nal, gak ma rey xon nu noka nak ma tub gazh rey, nu stub mbizh tira lux ma.
’Lee re chii kach kwaan myun lo lu, nak chii rey, xaa zer nabeyy; per zhin mbizh nabeyy xaa kwaan ma nakap, per nabeyy xaa nebse tubka gor.
Nu tubka kwaan nzhekla re xaa ne, nzhekla re xaa zaa xaa yalngezh nu yalnabeyy cheen xaa lo ma nakap.

Dil re xaa ne kwaan Mbakxiil cheen Dios, per lee Mbakxiil le gan lo re xaa, nel lee Mbakxiil nak Xaa Nabeyy lo re xaa nabeyy nu nak xaa Rey lo re rey. Nu lee re xaa nzo kwaan lee xaa nak re xaa kwaan mrezh xaa, nu re xaa kwaan mleey xaa, nu tira namlaat re xaa xaa.
Nu lee mandad noka né lo na: —Lee re nis kwaan myun lo lu, pa nzob ngwnaa, me nto cho lo re xaabyi, nak re dii, nu re myet, nu re yezh, nu xaa nzhedizh re dizhze.
Nu lee re chii kach kwaan myun lo lu, kwaan nzob yek ma nakap, yii ne ngwnaa me nto cho, nu kiib re kwaan lo me zee gak cheey me, nu gaw ma baal cheen me nu zek ma me lo ki.
Nu Dios mle zee lee chii kach myaan zaa yalnabeyy cheen xaa lo ma nakap, axta yilo gak re kwaan nzhé Dios.
Lee ngwnaa me myun lo lu, nak yezh ndok kwaan nabeyy lo rese rey yizhyo.
